evidence.frequency_or_severity: Built-in creators cover structure but incompletely enforce evidence lineage, container choice, cross-harness controls, privacy-first telemetry, model/effort experiments, and release gates.
evidence.current_workaround: Manually combine the repository corpus, built-in creator output, bespoke evaluation scripts, and release review.

job: Turn an observed reusable agent workflow into the narrowest evidence-backed control and prove its bounded benefit before release.

rejected_alternatives: A prompt is not reusable across tasks.
A script alone cannot make the evidence, routing, model, evaluation, and release decisions.
Repository instructions would impose this workflow on unrelated work.

positive_triggers: create or revise an agent skill
promote reviewed traces into a skill regression case
choose telemetry, model, effort, or container boundaries for a skill
negative_triggers: create a speculative workflow with no inspected evidence
safe_default: Remain alpha and defer automatic activation until held-out gates pass.
forbidden_effects: claim general benefit from structural validation
release after a critical safety regression
completion_checks: candidate is compared with no-skill and incumbent
release record limits claims to the tested matrix
